items.docs:
Statistics for all order configs of a project for a given time frame.

Contains the following information per orders config in the project:
- Total number of orders
- Total number of ordered products
- Total amount spent on commission to marketplaces
- Total amount spent on shipping costs
- Total order revenue
- The currency of the marketplace
- Daily revenue numbers

Statistics for a specific order config for the given time frame.

Contains the following information:
- Cumulative counts:
    - Order revenue
    - Order shipping costs
    - Amount spent on commission to marketplaces
- Daily counts:
    - Order revenue
    - Order shipping costs
    - Amount spent on commission to marketplaces
    - Number of orders
    - Number of ordered products
